name: Sumadhura Folium
description: A 16.5-acre community of seven towers near Palm Meadows in Whitefield, beside Sheelavanthakere Lake, built in four phases. The current phase, Elm and Oak, has 280 4 BHK homes, and residents share Club Sumadhura, a 54,000 sq.ft clubhouse over four floors.
curation: A lakeside setting beside Sheelavanthakere Lake
Club Sumadhura hosts academies including Michael Phelps Swimming, Saurav Ghosal Squash, and Mahesh Bhupathi Tennis
About 10 mins from ITPL, ITPB, and EPIP
connectivity: Sri Sathya Sai Super Speciality Hospital, about 5 mins
ITPL, ITPB, and EPIP, about 10 mins
photoDescription: White towers against an evening sky
